frame: the 99-species main sample of species_sample.json (11 per cell of the 3x3 grid of global by local record counts)

development.why: run and read during the shakedown; checker and key rules were changed after reading them

tranche1.rule: 3 species per cell, simple random sample without replacement within the cell, from the species not in the development set

pooling_rule: If nothing in the checker, the keys, the prompts or the evidence pack changes after tranche 1 has been read, tranches 1 and 2 are pooled as the confirmatory set. If anything changes, tranche 1 joins the development data and tranche 2 alone is confirmatory.

decisions.decision: Tranche 1 stays confirmatory after the citation fix.
decisions.reason: Between tranche 1 and tranche 2 the evidence pack changes only in the page number of its citation line (the stored page was the position inside the PDF, corrected to the book page on 2026-10-15). No key, rule, prompt or other evidence changed, and a page number cannot bear on whether an answer about elevation, slope, flowering, parks or uses is correct. Decided before tranche 2 was run.
